result: If it were mine to choose, I’d make power unable to numb empathy. The more influence anyone had over others, the more vividly they’d feel the real, specific consequences of their choices—not as abstractions, but as lived reality. Most large-scale harm depends on distance and numbness, so collapsing that distance would change almost everything.
